Furthermore, the company has seen strong profit growth over the trailing twelve months with a compounded rate of 68% [E20], which is significantly higher than the sector median profit growth of 17.5% [E67]. These metrics imply that LLOYDS may be undervalued and worth further investigation, as it has demonstrated consistent and robust sales and profit growth despite its current valuation.
